items.title: GameStop Still Wants eBay, and Its CEO Is Betting Big on Himself
items.summary: Ryan Cohen just wrote a personal check for a million shares of his own struggling company, and three directors bought the same week. When a CEO puts tens of millions of his own money in while quarterly sales crater, the question is what he knows that the market hasn't figured out yet.

items.title: eBay CFO Peggy Alford Sells 2,716 Shares in Tax-Related Transaction
items.summary: Alford maintains a direct position of 26,188 shares valued at $2.83 million, with the sale tied to restricted stock unit vesting obligations rather than discretionary trading.

items.title: How Much Upside Is Left In eBay Stock?
items.summary: eBay (EBAY) trades near $108 after a 22% return over the past year, against 18.5% for the S&P 500. The easy read is that the big gain is already in the price. But revenue grew 14.7% over the last twelve months, more than twice its three-year average. Management ties that growth to focused categories, preowned goods and newer lines such as eBay Live. A three-year scenario on eBay's own numbers shows how much of it could still reach the stock.
